title: Cached Playwright browsers in CI fail with 'Host system is missing dependencies to run browsers'
symptoms: Host system is missing dependencies to run browsers.
Failures start only on cache-hit runs that skip npx playwright install --with-deps
Executable doesn't exist after a version bump because the cache key ignores the Playwright version
cause: A cache can restore the browser folder but not the system libraries that install --with-deps adds through apt. Playwright's docs advise against caching browsers for that reason.
fix: Drop the cache and run install --with-deps every time, or key the cache on the exact Playwright version and still run install-deps on a cache hit.
apply:
- run: npx playwright install --with-deps
# if you keep a cache, still run this on a hit:
- run: npx playwright install-deps
affected: All Playwright versions on GitHub Actions and other CI runners
